items.issue: The Short says goals, feedback and a good mentor produce useful progress but supplies no evaluation standard or outcome evidence.
items.disposition: Keep as the speaker's teaching view; do not infer that a named mentor, course or practice volume is effective.

items.issue: The portable method is already represented by formal sources on stopping blind repetition and adjusting from failure feedback.
items.disposition: Assign zero formal weight and retain only as a concise restatement.
